description: Verify ArgoCD applications are Synced/Healthy after promotion merges for staging environments
method: kubectl get application perfect-api-staging slow-api-staging -n argocd; kubectl get pods in staging namespaces
expected: Both apps should be Synced/Healthy with running pods after staging PRs were merged
actual: Both perfect-api-staging and slow-api-staging are Synced/Healthy with Succeeded operations. Pods are Running 1/1 in their respective namespaces.

evidence.observation: ArgoCD Source Hydrator + autoSync with selfHeal ensures apps converge to desired state within seconds of branch merge
